verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a Drop-in Element for web checkout that embeds in the merchant's own page. It adapts input fields by payment method and country, and accepts appearance and layout options in createElement(...). Billing checkout also offers embedded checkout and elements alongside the hosted page, and the components-sdk is the recommended library. missing for 10: native mobile app SDK evidence for in-app embedding, deeper documentation of customization scope beyond brief snippets, independent or hands-on corroboration.
